system.description:
Reference Book: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy at War

Emplacement Points: 2

A devious weapon created by the Separatists during the Clone Wars, the Defoliator weapon affects living creatures, literally burning them up. When exposed to the weapon, organic matter is converted into energy, causing living creatures within the weapon's area of effect to quickly burn to ash. The Separatists first experiment with this weapon on Maridun. The Defoliator is fired into the field of combat, devastating living enemies while leaving the Separatists' Droid forces unharmed.

Defoliator Shell

Emplacement Points: 0

Droids take no damage from a Defoliator Shell, and only creatures completely sheltered within sealed Vehicles, Environmental Suits, or energy shields can avoid the effect of the weapon. When a Defoliator Shell damages a living creature, the creature takes the same amount of damage at the start of each subsequent turn until dead. If a creature takes damage from a Defoliator Shell but is not killed, it can stop the recurring damage only by passing through an energy shield that blocks out the weapon's effect (thus clearing the body of the biological agents causing the damage).
